title: MasterMind Review // Worship Rehab - Phil Thompson & My Worship

top_liked.author: @essenceoneessence
top_liked.text: Thank you for sharing! I was in the choir so it took a lot of effort to get these degrading songs out of my head. The worst had the lyrics, “I’m nothing without you”. There are no conditions of which I’m a deemed as “nothing”. But I played these songs to uplift me. SMH.  …
